title: Kyuri no Sunomono
description: Paper-thin cucumber salted, squeezed, and dressed in sweetened rice vinegar with wakame and sesame. A cool, sharp palate-cleaner.
notes: Add a little crab or cooked prawn to make it a starter.

steps.text: Slice the cucumbers paper-thin, toss with the salt, and leave to wilt.
steps.tip: Salting then squeezing lets the cucumber absorb the dressing instead of watering it down.

steps.text: Soak the wakame in cold water until it unfurls, then drain and squeeze dry.
Stir the rice vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Squeeze the cucumber firmly, toss with the wakame and dressing, and chill briefly. Serve topped with the sesame seeds.
